title: Wither bone
description: Add resources to the wither skeleton !
body:
![wither bone by kheyde](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f730788a6e57d7155a6c7470dc549395ff347fe9.png)

This mod adds wither skeleton bones with a drop rate similar to the base skeleton. You can grind them into powder or a block of black bone powder. This powder is 10 times more effective than regular bone powder, guaranteeing the growth of most crops in your world.
